sentences.en: By and large, women can bear pain better than men.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，女性比男性更能忍受疼痛。

sentences.en: The doctor gave him some drugs to relieve the pain.
sentences.zh: 医生给他开了一些药物来缓解他的疼痛。

sentences.en: When I have migraines, aspirin doesn't alleviate the pain for me.
sentences.zh: 当我头痛时，阿司匹林对我没有减轻疼痛的效果。

phrases.zh: 关于痛苦的；由……引起的痛苦
